name: eaoin-desktop
description: EAOIN 2.0 — Ultimate Sandbox Engine (packaged desktop edition). A sellable Electron build of the voxel sandbox game.
author: EAOIN Engine Team

scripts.start: npm run build:game && npm run prepare && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:game && npm run prepare && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:game && npm run prepare && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:game && npm run prepare && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:game && npm run prepare && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win-portable: npm run build:game && npm run prepare && electron-builder --win portable
